checks.remediation: Ship the release without sourcesContent. Remove the source maps or omit sourcesContent from maps that ship.
Do not ship source maps beside the release.
Set FuseV1Options.RunAsNode to false with @electron/fuses before packaging.
Set FuseV1Options.EnableEmbeddedAsarIntegrityValidation to true with @electron/fuses. Electron compiles this check for macOS and Windows; an ELF byte stays unknown.
Set FuseV1Options.OnlyLoadAppFromAsar to true with @electron/fuses so the packaged app loads application code from app.asar.
Set FuseV1Options.EnableNodeCliInspectArguments to false with @electron/fuses so the packaged app ignores --inspect.
Readable members are part of this package format. Treat packaged sources as public. This check does not rewrite the artifact.
Do not ship .pdb, .dSYM, .debug, or linker map files beside the release.
Rebuild without a CodeView PDB path, or accept that the path string is recoverable from the PE. The PDB file itself is a separate check.
Rebuild with -trimpath so file paths are not written into the binary. Module names can remain.
Omit cargo-auditable metadata from the release if the crate list should not ship.
Remove the provider-prefixed credential from the shipped text and rotate it if it is real. This check reports the rule id and location only.
This audit does not assess native hardening. Use inspect_binary_hardening when that tool is available.
This audit does not assess the Mach-O hardened runtime. inspect_signature reads code signatures and would change this tool's effects, so it stays a next probe.
This audit does not read Android manifests. Use inspect_android_package, which needs JADX.

allowances: Selected file reads stop at 268435456 bytes.
Text member scans read at most 262144 bytes each and 4194304 bytes in total.
HTML script targets keep at most 1048576 bytes of resolved paths. Later targets stay unassessed.
Local source map targets keep at most 1048576 bytes of resolved paths. Later targets stay unassessed.
Source map scans read at most 32 maps and 1048576 bytes each. sourcesContent text is counted and then dropped.

Other files and package members are identified from their first 4096 bytes, and those without a NUL byte in that prefix are scanned as text. Up to 64 packaged PE images are read for debug records, 262144 bytes each.

Packaged ELF, Mach-O, and PE images are read in full and copied to a temporary file to probe for an embedded package. They share one max_file_bytes allowance, and an image that does not fit is not probed.
Go, Rust, and Electron fuse readers run on at most 4 native images.

omitted.subject: source maps
omitted.reason: A source map exceeded the map count or byte allowance, could not be read, was a link that is not followed, was past the package entry cap or the HTML inline script limit, was declared but not found, or sat in a script an HTML file loads that was not examined as one; inline CSS source-map directives are not inspected.

omitted.subject: text members
omitted.reason: A text member exceeded the text byte allowance, could not be read, or was past the package entry cap.

limitations: This report states what static analysis of the selected artifact recovered. It does not establish that the application is secure.

ZIP inventory lists central-directory entries only. Non-entry bytes, including leading bytes before the first entry such as a self-extractor stub, an APK Signing Block before the central directory or a ZIP comment after it, are not occurrences.
Logical archive names collide under English (en-US) Unicode case folding; a case-insensitive destination cannot store both spellings. This comparison is not a filesystem observation.
